soldier: Soldier head brownish yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pronotum yellowish brown, head capsule moderately haired. Head capsule rectangular, the sides nearly parallel or slightly narrowing posteriorly, the dorsal margin of the head rather flat, the frontal slope about 45 degrees. Fontanelle small, dot-like, 0.62 mm from the anterior frontal margin, raised like a small hill. Labrum ligulate, short and broad. Mandibles rather straight, the apices slender and slightly curved, the mandibular basal ridge visible. Antennae 12–13-segmented, segment 2 very short, segment 3 inflated and more than twice segment 2. The upper margin of the antennal socket is expanded into a cover almost reaching the sides of the head. Eye spot visible. The waist region of the postmentum is slender and long, the waist constriction index 0.33. Pronotum butterfly-shaped, the anterior margin broad with a broad V-shaped median concavity, the lateral margins joining the posterior margin in an arc, the posterior margin without a median notch, the median area sparsely haired.
